avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin E (>400 IU/day)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate anticoagulant effects and increase bleeding risk in patients receiving concurrent anticoagulation
avoid_supplements.action: Limit vitamin E supplementation to RDA levels (15 mg/day); monitor for bleeding signs

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have immunomodulatory effects that could theoretically interfere with monoclonal antibody efficacy
caution_supplements.action: Monitor therapeutic response; discuss with oncology team before use

caution_supplements.name: Echinacea
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential immunostimulatory effects may interact with cancer immunotherapy mechanisms
caution_supplements.action: Avoid or use with caution; prioritize discussion with treating oncologist

caution_foods.name: High-sodium foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Hypertension is a known adverse effect of necitumumab; excess sodium intake may exacerbate this risk
caution_foods.action: Maintain sodium restriction (<2,300 mg/day) and monitor blood pressure regularly

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: No direct interaction with protein drug, but used cautiously in patients on concurrent medications metabolized by CYP3A4
caution_foods.action: Avoid if taking additional CYP3A4-dependent medications; otherwise unrestricted

monitoring_notes: Necitumumab is a monoclonal antibody with no hepatic metabolism, minimizing direct drug-supplement interactions. Primary concerns are monitoring for infusion-related reactions, hypertension, hypomagnesemia, and skin toxicity; counsel patients to avoid immunostimulatory supplements that may interfere with therapeutic mechanism.
